_readme: Provenance for every image a North Palm Beach blog article may reference. An image renders on a North Palm Beach article only if its locality is exactly "North Palm Beach" and it has a source and a verification note. File names prove nothing. Entries marked provisional are recorded for North Palm Beach but the exact place is unconfirmed; the audit reports them on every run. Enforced by scripts/audit-city-images.mjs (runs before every build) and tested by scripts/npb-image-guard.test.mjs.

images.landmark: A golf course edge and a waterway with a drawbridge tower and condominium towers behind
images.source: north-palm-001.jpg: photograph in the DO Homes Group site library under public/images/north-palm-beach, in use on North Palm Beach articles since June 2026. Low resolution (756x756); not used for any hero.
images.verification: Provisional: the file is part of the North Palm Beach library as supplied by the owner, but the exact location where it was taken has not been confirmed. Captions and alt text therefore describe only what is visible and name no venue. Confirm the location and photographer before treating these pages as final.
images.license: Owned by DO Homes Group (site photograph library); photographer credit to be confirmed by John Oliver
